subject.title: feat(ui): gateway SSO postMessage token handoff and ack

question: Should the Control UI accept gateway bearer tokens through a hosted-parent `postMessage` protocol, and if so which exact HTTPS origins and embedder contract are approved?
rationale: This determines whether a new cross-origin bearer-token ingress path belongs in the core Control UI; mechanical fixes cannot safely choose that security boundary.

options.title: Approve a narrow HTTPS protocol
options.body: Define the exact production origins, HTTPS-only rule, framing assumptions, acknowledgement semantics, and required live proof before repairing the branch.

options.title: Keep existing token handoffs
options.body: Do not add this listener; retain the current native injection and URL-fragment token paths instead.

options.title: Move it to the hosted owner
options.body: Keep hosted SSO-specific embedding logic outside core unless a generic approved Control UI integration seam is needed.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow HTTPS protocol
recommendation.body: Define the exact production origins, HTTPS-only rule, framing assumptions, acknowledgement semantics, and required live proof before repairing the branch.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposed hosted SSO integration and are the only directly evidenced routing contact; product/security approval still requires an authorized OpenClaw owner.
